例句

  • A diet high in fibre and protein gives your body the nutrients it needs.（富含纤维和蛋白质的饮食能给身体提供所需的营养。）
  • Many people struggle to sleep, but there is no single effective solution.（很多人睡不好，但没有哪一个办法是万能的。）
  • Some companies claim their supplements work immediately, but the research is limited.（有些公司声称自己的保健品马上见效，但相关研究很有限。）
  • Scientists evaluated people's sugar intake in the laboratory and found a clear impact on sleep quality.（科学家在实验室评估了人们的糖摄入量，发现它对睡眠质量有明显影响。）

过关标准：遮住中文看英文，能说出 22 个以上的意思，再挑 5 个自己造句（饮食、健康、睡眠在写作 Task 2 和口语 Part 1 都很常见）。

BBC 6 Minute English：What should you eat for a better night's sleep?（10 月 22 日）。这集讲吃什么能睡得更好，前半段两个主持人聊天比较好懂，中间两位专家的话句子长一些。音频和原文都已经放在页面里，不用打开 BBC 网站。

  1. 先把上面的听前生词过一遍，听不太懂可以先读懂原文再听。
  2. 第一遍不看文字，只听大意，回答开头的问题：专家说成年人每晚需要 7 到 9 小时睡眠，英国有百分之多少的人说自己睡不够？a) 15% b) 25% c) 35%
  3. 第二遍点开下面的原文精听，听不出的地方暂停、倒回去并标出来。Marie-Pierre St-Onge 那段（讲地中海饮食和纤维）语速快、词难，多听几遍。
  4. 第三遍挑 Phil 开头讲自己失眠那段（"You know, I do sometimes..."）跟读，模仿语调和连读。
  5. 记住 6 个表达：nutrients（营养素）、saturated fats（饱和脂肪）、deep sleep（深度睡眠）、supplements（补充剂）、feed information（大量灌输信息）、magic bullet（灵丹妙药）。
点开看原文（难词带中文，点虚线词显示）
💡 点击或悬停虚线词看中文；点击说话人名字可单独切换该段翻译

Phil：Hi Georgie.

Phil：嗨，乔治（Georgie）。

Georgie：Hi Phil. Now, Phil, do you ever struggle to get a good night's sleep?

Georgie：嗨，菲尔（Phil）。菲尔，你有没有过很难睡个好觉的时候？

Phil：You know, I do sometimes. If I've been thinking about something a lot, or even worse, if I've had a cup of coffee later than I should, sometimes I can lie there for hours躺好几个小时睡不着.

Phil：还真有，有时候会这样。如果我一直在想某件事，或者更糟的是，喝咖啡喝得太晚了，有时我会在床上躺好几个小时都睡不着。

Georgie：Yes. Well, many of us will be familiar with熟悉 that feeling of lying in bed, feeling really tired, but just not being able to go to sleep, but what causes us to struggle to sleep and is there anything we can do about it? Well, researchers have for a while been interested in the link between what we eat and how we sleep. Today on 6 Minute English, we'll be talking about this and asking, "What should you eat for a better night's sleep?" OK. Phil, let's start with a quiz question. So, adults need between 7–9 hours sleep a night to stay healthy, according to experts, but what percentage of people in the UK say they get less than this? Is it:
a) 15%,
b) 25%, or
c) 35%?

Georgie：是的。很多人应该都熟悉这种感觉：躺在床上，明明觉得特别累，却就是睡不着。但到底是什么让我们难以入睡？我们又有什么办法应对呢？其实，研究人员一直对饮食和睡眠之间的关系很感兴趣。在今天的《六分钟英语》里，我们就来聊聊这个话题，并探讨：“想要睡得更好，应该吃些什么？”好，菲尔，我们先从一个小测验开始。专家表示，成年人每晚需要睡7到9个小时才能保持健康，但在英国，有百分之多少的人表示自己睡不到这个时长呢？是：a) 15%，b) 25%，还是 c) 35%？

Phil：OK. I think people find sleeping hard, so I think it's going to be c) 35%.

Phil：好。我觉得大家普遍觉得睡觉挺难的，所以我猜是 c) 35%。

Georgie：OK. Well, we'll find out the answer later in the programme.

Georgie：好的，我们在节目稍后揭晓答案。

Phil：Georgie, you've been looking at the research on this. Do scientists think that what we eat affects how we sleep?

Phil：乔治，你一直在看这方面的研究。科学家们认为我们吃的东西会影响睡眠吗？

Georgie：Yes, they do. Scientists have done some long-term长期的 studies. So, looking at large groups of people over a long period of time, and they found that a healthier diet is associated with与…有关 better quality sleep. They've also done some smaller studies looking in more detail at exactly what people are eating and then studying how they sleep in a laboratory实验室.

Georgie：是的，他们确实这么认为。科学家们做过一些长期研究，也就是在很长一段时间里跟踪调查大群人，结果发现更健康的饮食与更高质量的睡眠有关。他们也做过一些较小规模的研究，更细致地观察人们具体吃了什么，然后在实验室里监测他们的睡眠情况。

Phil：OK. And in these studies, have they found that particular foods are better for our sleep than others?

Phil：好的。那在这些研究中，他们有没有发现某些特定的食物比其他食物更助眠呢？

Georgie：Well, it's less about particular foods and more about particular nutrients营养素. So, nutrients营养素 means important things your body needs to survive and be healthy. For example, protein蛋白质 is a nutrient. BBC World Service programme The Food Chain has been speaking to researcher Professor Marie-Pierre St-Onge about which nutrients营养素 are important for sleep.

Georgie：嗯，重点不太在于某几种特定的食物，而在于特定的营养素（nutrients）。营养素指的是身体为了维持生命和保持健康所必需的重要物质。比如，蛋白质就是一种营养素。BBC世界服务频道的《食物链》（The Food Chain）节目采访了研究员玛丽-皮埃尔·圣翁日（Marie-Pierre St-Onge）教授，探讨哪些营养素对睡眠很重要。

Marie-Pierre St-Onge：So, diets that look more like a Mediterranean地中海的 pattern – higher in fruits and vegetables, whole grains谷物（whole grains 全谷物）, lower in animal-based foods动物性食物, lower in sugar. But then from our own research, where we evaluate评估 food intakes摄入量 in the lab, we see different... similar patterns, really. But when we talk about nutrients营养素, diets that are higher in fibre膳食纤维, which we find in fruits and vegetables and whole grains谷物（whole grains 全谷物）, and lower in saturated fats饱和的（saturated fat 饱和脂肪）, which we find in more plant-based植物性的 types of foods, are associated with与…有关 more deep sleep深度睡眠 at night.

Marie-Pierre St-Onge：更接近地中海饮食模式的饮食——也就是富含水果、蔬菜和全谷物，动物性食物较少，糖分也较低。而从我们自己在实验室评估食物摄入量的研究来看，我们也发现了不同……其实是很相似的规律。但具体说到营养素，膳食纤维含量较高（主要来自水果、蔬菜和全谷物）、同时饱和脂肪含量较低（更多见于植物性饮食结构）的饮食，与夜间更多的深度睡眠有关。

Georgie：Marie-Pierre says that Mediterranean-style diets are associated with与…有关 good sleep. A Mediterranean地中海的 diet includes lots of vegetables and less animal-based foods动物性食物 such as meat and dairy奶制品.

Georgie：玛丽-皮埃尔说，地中海式的饮食与良好的睡眠有关。地中海饮食包含大量的蔬菜，而肉类和奶制品等动物性食物较少。

Phil：Yes, and Marie-Pierre's own research shows that some nutrients营养素, such as fibre膳食纤维, are important for sleep and others, such as saturated fats饱和的（saturated fat 饱和脂肪）, are less important. Saturated fat饱和的（saturated fat 饱和脂肪） is a type of fat mainly found in meat and dairy奶制品 that's thought to be bad for your health.

Phil：没错，而且玛丽-皮埃尔自己的研究表明，有些营养素（比如膳食纤维）对睡眠很重要，而另一些（比如饱和脂肪）就不那么有利。饱和脂肪是一种主要存在于肉类和奶制品中的脂肪，通常被认为对健康不利。

Georgie：Right. And according to Marie-Pierre, eating less saturated fat饱和的（saturated fat 饱和脂肪） and more nutrients营养素 like fibre膳食纤维 is associated with与…有关 more deep sleep深度睡眠 at night. A deep sleep深度睡眠 is when you are more fully asleep and your body is able to rest.

Georgie：对。根据玛丽-皮埃尔的说法，少吃饱和脂肪、多摄入像膳食纤维这样的营养素，与夜间更多的深度睡眠有关。深度睡眠（deep sleep）是指你睡得非常沉、身体能够充分休息的状态。

Phil：So, Georgie, it sounds like thinking about our diets is important if we want to improve our sleep. And now I've heard that certain foods have a lot of nutrients营养素 that can be helpful for sleep. Is that true?

Phil：那么乔治，听起来如果我们想改善睡眠，注意日常饮食是很重要的。不过我听说有些食物含有大量有助于睡眠的营养素，这是真的吗？

Georgie：Well, there is some limited research on specific foods and their impact on sleep. So, for example, scientists have been studying kiwi fruits and also tart酸的 cherry juice. And you may also see adverts广告 for supplements补充剂，保健品 that claim to improve sleep. Supplements补充剂，保健品 are tablets you take, which contain particular nutrients营养素 that you might not get in your everyday diet. But experts say that focusing on our whole diet, rather than而不是 one particular fruit or supplement补充剂，保健品, is going to be the most effective. Here's sleep doctor Allie Hare explaining more to BBC World Service programme The Food Chain.

Georgie：嗯，目前针对特定食物及其对睡眠影响的研究还比较有限。比如，科学家们一直在研究猕猴桃和酸樱桃汁。另外，你大概也见过声称能改善睡眠的保健品（supplements）广告。补充剂/保健品是你服用的药片，里面含有日常饮食中可能摄取不足的特定营养素。但专家表示，关注整体饮食结构，而不是指望某一种水果或某一种保健品，才是最有效的。下面是睡眠医生阿莉·黑尔（Allie Hare）在BBC世界服务《食物链》节目中的进一步解释。

Allie Hare：I think people are looking for the one supplement补充剂，保健品 often or the... you know, we're fed a lot of these things被灌输了很多这类东西, aren't we, on social media? This magical powder or this magical tablet that you can take that will, you know, help you sleep better immediately from tonight. And of course, you know, Marie-Pierre and I know that there is no such magic bullet子弹（magic bullet 灵丹妙药）, unfortunately. And if there was, I'm sure, you know, we would be... we would be doing very well for ourselves混得很好，赚大钱了.

Allie Hare：我觉得人们往往在寻找某一种管用的保健品，或者……你知道，我们在社交媒体上被灌输了太多这类东西，不是吗？像是某种神奇粉末或神奇药片，吃下去从今晚开始就能立刻睡个好觉。当然，玛丽-皮埃尔和都很清楚，很遗憾，世上并没有这样的“灵丹妙药”（magic bullet）。如果真有的话，我敢肯定我们早就赚得盆满钵满了。

Phil：Allie says people are looking for a supplement补充剂，保健品 that can help them sleep.

Phil：阿莉说，人们总在寻找一种能帮自己入睡的保健品。

Georgie：Yes. She says we are fed information on social media about magical tablets. If you are fed information, you are given lots of it in a continuous way持续不断地.

Georgie：是的。她说我们在社交媒体上被大量灌输（fed information）关于神奇药片的信息。如果你“被灌输信息”（fed information），意思就是别人源源不断地向你塞入大量信息。

Phil：But Allie argues that experts know there's no magic bullet子弹（magic bullet 灵丹妙药） to help you sleep, and a magic bullet子弹（magic bullet 灵丹妙药） refers to a simple and effective solution to a problem that's usually one that doesn't exist. OK. Well, now I think it's time to find out the answer to your quiz question, Georgie.

Phil：但阿莉指出，专家们知道助眠并没有什么“灵丹妙药”（magic bullet）；magic bullet 指的是能简单又有效地解决问题的妙方，而且往往现实中并不存在。好，乔治，我觉得现在该揭晓你开头那个小测验的答案了。

Georgie：Yes. I asked you what percentage of UK adults say they get less than seven hours sleep a night.

Georgie：好的。我问你的是：有百分之多少的英国成年人表示自己每晚睡眠不足7小时。

Phil：And I said I thought it was c) 35%.

Phil：我说我猜是 c) 35%。

Georgie：You are correct, Phil. Yes, 35% of adults say they get six hours or less sleep a night, according to a study by YouGov. OK. Let's recap回顾，总结 the vocabulary we learned in this programme, starting with nutrients营养素, which are important things your body needs to survive and be healthy.

Georgie：你答对了，菲尔！没错，根据 YouGov 的一项调查，35% 的成年人表示自己每晚只睡6个小时或更少。好，让我们来回顾一下这期节目学到的词汇，首先是 nutrients（营养素），即身体维持生命和保持健康所必需的重要物质。

Phil：Saturated fats饱和的（saturated fat 饱和脂肪） are fats mainly found in meat and dairy奶制品 products that are thought to be bad for our health.

Phil：Saturated fats（饱和脂肪）是指主要存在于肉类和奶制品中、被认为对健康有害的脂肪。

Georgie：A deep sleep深度睡眠 is when your body is fully asleep and able to rest.

Georgie：A deep sleep（深度睡眠）是指身体完全沉睡并能够得到充分休息的状态。

Phil：Supplements补充剂，保健品 are tablets or other things which contain particular nutrients营养素 you might not get in your everyday diet.

Phil：Supplements（补充剂/保健品）是指含有日常饮食中可能摄取不足的特定营养素的药片或其他制品。

Georgie：To feed information means to give lots of it in a continuous way持续不断地.

Georgie：To feed information（灌输信息）意思是持续不断地提供大量信息。

Phil：And a magic bullet子弹（magic bullet 灵丹妙药） is a simple and effective solution, and it's often one that doesn't exist.

Phil：而 a magic bullet（灵丹妙药）是指简单又有效的解决办法，而且通常并不存在。

Georgie：Once again, our six minutes are up, but don't forget you can test what you've learned with the worksheet练习题 on our website. Go to bbclearningenglish.com.

Georgie：我们的六分钟又到了，别忘了去我们的网站做练习题来测试你学到的内容。请访问 bbclearningenglish.com。

Phil：Thanks for joining us and goodbye.

Phil：感谢收听，再见。

Georgie：Goodbye!

Georgie：再见！

过关标准：不看原文能用中文说出这集讲了什么（饮食和睡眠有什么关系，哪些营养有帮助，为什么专家说没有灵丹妙药），6 个表达都知道意思，Phil 那段能流利读下来。

小练习

  1. Vegetables are full of vitamins and other ______.（营养素）
  2. Butter and cheese contain a lot of ______ ______.（饱和脂肪）
  3. I was in such a ______ ______ that I didn't hear the alarm.（深度睡眠）
  4. She takes vitamin D ______ in winter.（补充剂，用复数）
  5. We are ______ a lot of fake news on social media.（被大量灌输，用过去分词）
  6. There is no ______ ______ for losing weight; you need to eat well and exercise.（灵丹妙药）
点开看答案

开头那题选 c，YouGov 的调查显示 35% 的英国成年人每晚只睡 6 小时或更少，Phil 猜对了。填空：1. nutrients 2. saturated fats 3. deep sleep 4. supplements 5. fed 6. magic bullet
